brief: Make a memorable portfolio for theatre lighting designer Blackout Lab. Feature three lighting cues: Dusk (amber wash), Static (hard white side light) and Flood (blue backlight). A producer should be able to pick any cue and see what the light does, with the chosen name and technique in text. Nothing else is supplied.

Build an interactive editorial story called River Gauge. At 2 m the riverside path closes, at 4 m the ferry stops, and at 6 m the footbridge closes. Readers should be able to pick a water level and see all the closures at or below it. Make the three elevations feel real. Use only these facts.

Build a plain library room permit form. Ask for a name and one room, either Oak or Elm. Both answers are required. On an empty submission, explain what is missing in place. On success show the name and chosen room. Keep the form calm, quick, local and keyboard friendly.
